Record notes

Eight Mac maintenance workflows with complete recovery procedures and verified-copy helpers.

Version 0.2.2 includes 8 complete skill procedures. Complete original methods and shell helpers; receiving-host storage roles require configuration.

Requirements: macOS; Host terminal or computer-use tools.

License scope: MIT. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add mac-ops-toolkit@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files and includes a per-file hash inventory. Built from 65519bccb27654c9cc9bfd1878ed0084b48316a9. SHA-256: 874c34de59d5e5704b355409c1bce41666f1066d588490cdc0387e3825ac0975.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
